products.title: Art Of Arabia I
products.body_html:

As the fragrance evolves, it transitions into its heart notes, where a symphony of unique and intriguing accords awaits. Ginger adds a spicy and slightly piquant character, while lavender introduces a touch of herbal freshness. In the base, Art Of Arabia I Perfume reveals its depth and complexity. Olibanum, also known as frankincense, lends a resinous and spiritual quality to the composition, evoking the essence of Arabian culture. With its warm and spicy aroma, Cinnamon adds a final layer of depth and allure. Art Of Arabia I Perfume is a unisex fragrance that transcends gender boundaries. Its multifaceted and intriguing blend of notes makes it suitable for those who appreciate the complexity of their scents. Whether worn during the day or in the evening, this fragrance exudes an air of elegance and refinement. In summary, Art Of Arabia I Perfume pays homage to the beauty and mystique of Arabian traditions. Its harmonious fusion of citrus, tea, spices, and resins creates a captivating and memorable fragrance that celebrates the artistry and allure of Arabia.

Middle Notes

Base Notes

Champagne, Strawberry, Tangerine, Blood Orange, Rose

products.title: Fakhar Black
products.body_html:
Fakher Lattafa highlights a fougere - woody union along with elegant notes of violet leaf, masculine nutmeg and bergamot. The heart accentuates clary sage, tart geranium and orange blossom finely spiced with coriander, while tonka, patchouli, vanilla and sandalwood linger in trail, which attract our attention with strong creamy shades.

Top Notes
Apple, Bergamot, Ginger

Middle Notes
Lavender, Sage, Juniper Berries, Geranium

Base Notes
Tonka Bean, Cedar, Amberwood, Vetiver

products.title: Fakhar Women
products.body_html:
Light and fruity, this perfume opens on top notes of aldehydes, lilies, pomegranates and fruits. The sensual heart note revels in floral bouquet of roses, jasmine, and gardenias. The skillful finish is provided by a long lasting base of vanilla, sandalwood, ambroxan and white musk. This enchanting and sensual fragrance envelops its wearer in a cloud of florals and delicious notes.

Top Notes
Fruits, Lily, Pomegranate, Aldehydes

Middle Notes
Tuberose, Jasmine, Gardenia, Ylang-Ylang, Honeysuckle, Rose, Peony

Base Notes
Vanilla, White Musk, Sandalwood, Ambroxan
